items.title: Brunies Brother Band Interview, 1957-10-19
items.q: And Gordon Paulyat, when I put a show in there, he was on trombone.

ctx.x: And Gordon Paulyat, when I put a show in there, he was on trombone. And Gordon Paulyat, when I put a show in there, he was on trombone. And I couldn't read and I had to put a show in there. And I had to put a violin player, and a man that doubled on trumpet, so he could carry the lead, see? And I was directing the band.
Who was Lou King by the way?
